sources.title: IIITDM develops integrated machine that can process banana stem to make fibre yarn
sources.finding: Annadurai spearheaded an industry–institute initiative in which IIITDM faculty and students developed a banana pseudo-stem processing machine; Gencrest planned an associated pilot plant.
sources.scope: Contemporary reporting of development and plans, not evidence of later commercial performance.

sources.title: Chairmen of NDRF
sources.finding: The past-chairmen register lists Dr. M. Annadurai from 18 February 2019 to 7 March 2022.
sources.scope: The institutional register’s dates and organization name are used in both editions; the original collection remains preserved.

sources.title: Chandrayaan-1 / Moon Impact Probe
sources.finding: The mission combined Indian instruments with scientific equipment from the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, Sweden and Bulgaria; NASA’s M3 helped confirm water locked in lunar minerals.
sources.scope: Mission context and shared scientific contribution, not a claim of sole discovery by Annadurai.

rejectedClaims.reason: The listed inventors are Hangching Grant Wang and Rongsheng K Li, with Boeing as original assignee. Annadurai’s work is cited, but he is not listed as an inventor. No patent ownership or inventorship claim was added.
The description calls Annadurai a former ISRO chairman. This contradicts the documented satellite-centre directorship and was not adopted.
